issue.title: Restore downloadable Windows launcher acceptance artifacts in CI
issue.body:
Priority: P3. The Windows launcher CI job's upload-artifact step reports no files for `.tmp/windows-launcher-*/`; the run artifact listing confirms no Windows archive in the #419 and #435 evidence. Current #435 native alias records are preserved in structured job stdout, which was independently inspected; its acceptance does not rely on a nonexistent archive. Default hidden-directory exclusion is a plausible cause, not yet verified. The new alias sandbox is under OS TEMP and also needs an explicit evidence-only retention policy.

Acceptance:
- Establish why the actual uploader finds no files on a disposable hosted Windows run.
- Publish bounded useful native evidence with an explicit safe path, excluding gateway keys, credentials, live stores and directory links to the checkout.
- Verify the uploaded archive by downloading it, checking its contents and linking it to the exact tested head/run/job.
- Preserve stdout diagnostics and declared handling when a failed test leaves a process or link requiring later investigation.

Deferred as a pre-existing CI evidence-retention issue; #488 concerns a Gates deadline and is a different root cause. Review observation O2.

Origin: Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh formal scan 1 of PR #492 at `6f383da798872aa0e6bd1e0de1fdcd4e702de9ae` (full report in the PR conversation). Open and closed issue searches for symlink, entry, inert and artifact found no matching root cause.

Disposition: DEFER-ISSUE; parked under `backlog`, with no pickup gate. This follow-up does not expand the authorized four-intent batch or block #435. Preserve docs/15 delivery and independent opposite-family review when separately dispatched.

labels.name: backlog
labels.description: Parked until further notice: agents do not pick it up; it carries no gate label
